title: Unicyclic Graphs of Arbitrary Girth with the Same Chromatic Symmetric Function
summary: An open question asks whether the chromatic symmetric function (CSF) of a graph distinguishes non-isomorphic trees. While it is known that the CSF does not distinguish unicyclic graphs, examples of pairs of unicyclic graphs with the same CSF and girth larger than 3 were not known until very recently. This manuscript exhibits a sequence of pairs of non-isomorphic, connected, unicyclic graphs with increasing girth and which share the same CSF.
